name: polr-ai-skills
description: A public, MIT-licensed store of Claude Code skills from POLR AI. Install a skill with one command, or fork the whole repo and run your own marketplace.

plugins.name: daily-brief
plugins.description: Generate a tight one-screen daily brief that blends repo-based context (business plan, contracts, family, home) with live data from your connected MCP servers (CRM, email, calendar, accounting). Manually invoked; ships with a worked example and setup guide.

plugins.name: agentic-os
plugins.description: Turn an empty folder into a complete Agentic OS through a staged interview, then grow it one role at a time. Ships two skills: bootstrap-company and add-new-agent.

plugins.name: x-twitter-scraper
plugins.description: Plan Xquik X/Twitter data workflows for REST API setup, MCP setup, SDKs, webhooks, exports, monitors, and confirmation-gated actions.
